metadata.title: That One Kill Where Valorant Said ‘You’re Good Enough’ and I’m Still Confused
metadata.description:
I swear I missed but the game said nope.
Enemy probably uninstalling from sheer confusion.
How did that even happen? Not my aim for sure.

Hit like if your aim’s ever ghosted but you still got the kill!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckykill #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
